violations.description: HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): A hand drying device was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the ware-washing area. Paper towels were replaced in the dispenser to correct the violation.

FOOD DISPLAY SERVICE AND TRANSPORT TEMP (5 pts): Ice cream mix basin/resovior noted with a cold holding temperature above 41 degrees fahrenheit. Vanilla and Chocolate mix both noted at 55?F. The critical violation re-inspection will occur on or before 9-25-25 unless the Inspector is contacted to delay re-inspection.The unit will either need to be repaired or phyiscally removed from service to correct the violation.
